---
title: "Useful keyboard shortcuts"
---

|Mac | PC | Result | 
|---| --- | --- |
|<kbd>Option</kbd><kbd>-</kbd> | <kbd>ALT</kbd><kbd>-</kbd> | `<-` |
|<kbd>Command</kbd><kbd>Shift</kbd><kbd>M</kbd> | <kbd>Control</kbd><kbd>Shift</kbd><kbd>M</kbd> | `%>%` |
|<kbd>Command</kbd><kbd>Enter</kbd> | <kbd>Control</kbd><kbd>Enter</kbd> | Run selected code |
| <kbd>Command</kbd><kbd>Shift</kbd><kbd>C</kbd> | <kbd>Control</kbd><kbd>Shift</kbd><kbd>C</kbd> | Comment/uncomment selected lines | 
| <kbd>Option</kbd><kbd>&rarr;</kbd> | <kbd>Control</kbd><kbd>&rarr;</kbd> | Navigates word-by-word |
| <kbd>Option</kbd> drag | <kbd>Alt</kbd> drag | Edit multiple rows |

Holding <kbd>Shift</kbd> while arrowing by character/word/row to select
